meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: MUST USE for planning before coding when design uncertainty remains after discovery: ambiguous scope, competing decompositions, unclear boundaries, uncertain dependency ordering, architecture decisions, a vague 'just make it good / figure out what to build' brief, or any request to plan, interview, or break work down. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode, just make it good, figure out what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前制定完整的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手编码前先理清范围、依赖和架构。
copy.tagline_en: Create a complete work plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify scope, dependencies, and architecture before writing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先探索代码库，只问必须由你决定的问题，然后等你批准，最后写出一份完整的、工人可直接执行的工作计划，不再需要你进一步解释。
howto.when: 当你说“做个计划”、“规划一下”、“先别做，先规划”等，或者需求模糊（如“把它做好”、“想清楚要做什么”）时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一下这个新功能怎么做。
say.note: Claude 会开始探索并提问，然后等你批准再写计划。

say.text: 先别写代码，先做个计划。
say.note: Claude 会进入规划模式，不会直接实现。

say.text: 把登录模块拆解成任务列表。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码库，生成详细的工作计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first explores the codebase, asks only the questions you must decide, waits for your approval, then writes one complete work plan that a worker can execute without further interview.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'plan this', 'make a plan', 'break this down', or when the request is vague like 'just make it good' or 'figure out what to build'.

say_en.text: Plan this new feature for me.
Don't code yet, just plan first.
say_en.note: Claude enters plan mode and will not implement.

say_en.text: Break down the login module into tasks.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the codebase and generates a detailed work plan.
